sections.title: USB-C power
notes: Power only: nothing on this board uses USB data.

sections.title: Two-wire probe
sections.purpose: Goes high when water bridges the wires.
notes: 1 Mohm holds it low when dry, and 10 kohm protects the transistor from static on the wires.
The 200 kohm wet resistance is an assumption about the water and the wire spacing, not a measurement.

sections.title: Buzzer
sections.purpose: Sounds while the wires are wet.
notes: The buzzer has its own oscillator, so it only needs switching on.
The diode takes the coil’s kick when the transistor turns off.
